# Varvara CSS

> Brutalist CSS component library: square corners, 1px solid borders, no shadows, plain class names (`va-button`, `va-card`, `va-input`...), fully customizable through CSS variables. Zero JavaScript, ~3KB gzipped.

Varvara CSS ships prebuilt UI components as plain CSS classes. It can be used standalone or alongside Tailwind CSS, with any JavaScript framework. Install via CDN (`@import url('https://unpkg.com/varvara-css');`) or npm (`npm i varvara-css`).

Note: component pages on this site render code samples through a custom `<va-code-block>` element that requires JavaScript, so a plain crawl of the HTML will not surface the example markup. See `llms-full.txt` for the actual class names, markup shapes, and variable reference in plain text.

## Docs

- [Get started](https://varvara.js.org/get-started): Installation via CDN or npm, basic usage.
- [CSS Variables](https://varvara.js.org/variables): Full reference of border, icon, color, typography, and spacing variables.
- [Components](https://varvara.js.org/components): Index of every component with live examples.
- [Button](https://varvara.js.org/components/button)
- [Button Group](https://varvara.js.org/components/button-group)
- [Card](https://varvara.js.org/components/card)
- [Checkbox](https://varvara.js.org/components/checkbox)
- [Collapse](https://varvara.js.org/components/collapse)
- [Icon](https://varvara.js.org/components/icon)
- [Input](https://varvara.js.org/components/input)
- [Link](https://varvara.js.org/components/link)
- [Loading](https://varvara.js.org/components/loading)
- [Select](https://varvara.js.org/components/select)
- [Table](https://varvara.js.org/components/table)
- [Code Block](https://varvara.js.org/code-block): Separate package, `<va-code-block>` custom element for syntax-highlighted snippets.
- [Changelog](https://varvara.js.org/changelog)

## Optional

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/marcmarine/varvara-js): Monorepo source (css, typedoc-theme, code-block packages).
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/varvara-css)
- [Full component & variable reference](https://varvara.js.org/llms-full.txt): Complete plain-text reference with exact markup patterns and known limitations, written for LLM/agent consumption.
